allow_downsize_reboot.description: Single opt-in for disruptive scaling. Defaults to false: in-place upgrades that need no reboot happen automatically, but any scale that DOWNSIZES (reduces mem/cpu/disk) or otherwise requires a REBOOT is rejected during terraform apply before the scale API call instead of silently downsizing/rebooting a running server (a downsize always reboots on this platform). Set true to permit downsize+reboot. This guards against an out-of-band portal scale-up being silently reverted.
